        <SchemeName>
            <Name xml:lang="en">EU:List containing the information notified by third countries to facilitate the validation of electronic signatures or seals created in third countries as meeting the requirements of (EU) advanced electronic signatures or seals in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council on electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions in the internal market. This list shall under no circumstances be used in the context of recognition in accordance with Article 14(1) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014.</Name>

        <PolicyOrLegalNotice>
            <TSLLegalNotice xml:lang="en">The present list contains the information notified by third countries to facilitate the validation of advanced electronic signatures and advanced electronic seals created in third countries for their recognition and use in public online services of EU and EEA Member States, in the context of Article 27(1) and Article 37(1) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council on electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions in the internal market. This list shall under no circumstances be used in the context of a recognition in accordance with Article 14(1) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014. The European Commission maintains this list and the website on which it is published as interoperability tools. The goal of the Commission is to keep this information timely and accurate. If errors are brought to our attention, we will try to correct them. However, the Commission accepts no responsibility or liability whatsoever about the content of national Trusted Lists which lies exclusively with the designated third country. It is our goal to minimise disruption caused by technical errors. However, some data or information on our website may have been created or structured in files or formats that are not error-free and we cannot guarantee that our service will not be interrupted or otherwise affected by such problems. The European Commission accepts no responsibility about any problem incurred as a result of using this list and the website on which it is published or any linked external sites or information. This disclaimer is not intended to limit the liability of the European Commission in contravention of any requirements laid down in applicable national law nor to exclude its liability for matters which may not be excluded under that law.</TSLLegalNotice>
        </PolicyOrLegalNotice>

                                <mra:CertificateContentReferencesEquivalenceList>
                                    <mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalence>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalenceContext>http://ec.europa.eu/tools/lotl/mra/QcCompliance</mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalenceContext>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointingParty assert="none">
                                            <ns5:Description>MD qualified certificates may not be considered as legally equivalent to eIDAS qualified certificates. For eIDAS qualified certificates, the QcStatement "QcCompliance" (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance OID "0.4.0.1862.1.1") is the reference machine processable statement included in a certificate to declare (as a statement made by the issuing QTSP) and to confirm (as a benchmark for establishing the content of the corresponding trust service entry in the corresponding national trusted list) that it has been issued as a qualified certificate.</ns5:Description>
                                            <ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                                <mra:QcStatementSet>
                                                    <mra:QcStatement>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementId>
                                                            <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.1</ns4:Identifier>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementId>
                                                    </mra:QcStatement>
                                                </mra:QcStatementSet>
                                            </ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                        </mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointingParty>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointedParty assert="all">
                                            <ns5:Description>Under the Moldovan regulatory framework for trust services, the QcStatement "QcCompliance" (id-etsi-qcs-QcType OID "0.4.0.1862.1.1") used together with the QcStatement "QcCCLegislation" (id-etsi-qcs-QcType OID "0.4.0.1862.1.7") with value "MD" is the reference machine processable statement included in a certificate to declare (as a statement made by the issuing TSP) that it has been issued as a qualified moldovan certificate.</ns5:Description>
                                            <ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                                <mra:QcStatementSet>
                                                    <mra:QcStatement>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementId>
                                                            <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.1</ns4:Identifier>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementId>
                                                    </mra:QcStatement>
                                                    <mra:QcStatement>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementId>
                                                            <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.7</ns4:Identifier>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementId>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementInfo>
                                                            <mra:QcCClegislation>MD</mra:QcCClegislation>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementInfo>
                                                    </mra:QcStatement>
                                                </mra:QcStatementSet>
                                            </ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                        </mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointedParty>
                                    </mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalence>
                                    <mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalence>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalenceContext>http://ec.europa.eu/tools/lotl/mra/QcType</mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalenceContext>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointingParty assert="all">
                                            <ns5:Description>Under eIDAS, the QcStatement "QcType" (id-etsi-qcs-QcType OID "0.4.0.1862.1.6") with value id-etsi-qct-esign (OID "0.4.0.1862.1.6.1") is the reference machine processable statement included in a certificate to declare (as a statement made by the issuing TSP) that it has been issued as a certificate for electronic signature.</ns5:Description>
                                            <ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                                <mra:QcStatementSet>
                                                    <mra:QcStatement>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementId>
                                                            <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.6</ns4:Identifier>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementId>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementInfo>
                                                            <mra:QcType>
                                                                <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.6.1</ns4:Identifier>
                                                            </mra:QcType>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementInfo>
                                                    </mra:QcStatement>
                                                </mra:QcStatementSet>
                                            </ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                        </mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointingParty>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointedParty assert="all">
                                            <ns5:Description>Under the Moldovan regulatory framework for trust services, the QcStatement "QcType" (id-etsi-qcs-QcType OID "0.4.0.1862.1.6") with value id-etsi-qct-esign (OID "0.4.0.1862.1.6.1") is the reference machine processable statement included in a certificate to declare (as a statement made by the issuing TSP) that it has been issued as a certificate for electronic signature.</ns5:Description>
                                            <ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                              <mra:QcStatementSet>
                                                    <mra:QcStatement>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementId>
                                                            <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.6</ns4:Identifier>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementId>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementInfo>
                                                            <mra:QcType>
                                                                <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.6.1</ns4:Identifier>
                                                            </mra:QcType>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementInfo>
                                                    </mra:QcStatement>
                                                </mra:QcStatementSet>
                                            </ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                        </mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointedParty>
                                    </mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalence>
                                    <mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalence>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalenceContext>http://ec.europa.eu/tools/lotl/mra/QcQSCD</mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalenceContext>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointingParty assert="none">
                                            <ns5:Description>MD qualified electronic signature creation devices referenced by means of the presence of the QcStatement "QcSSCD" in MD qualified certificates may not be considered as legally equivalent to eIDAS qualified electronic signature creation devices. For eIDAS qualified certificates, the QcStatement "QcSSCD" (id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD OID "0.4.0.1862.1.4") is the reference machine processable statement included in a certificate to declare (as a statement made by the issuing TSP) and to confirm (as a benchmark for establishing the content of the corresponding trust service entry in the corresponding national trusted list) that the private key, to which the certified public key corresponds, resides in an EU qualified electronic signature or seal creation device.</ns5:Description>
                                            <ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                                <mra:QcStatementSet>
                                                    <mra:QcStatement>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementId>
                                                            <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.4</ns4:Identifier>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementId>
                                                    </mra:QcStatement>
                                                </mra:QcStatementSet>
                                            </ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                        </mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointingParty>
                                        <mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointedParty assert="all">
                                            <ns5:Description>Under the Moldovan regulatory framework for trust services, the QcStatement "QcSSCD" (id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD OID "0.4.0.1862.1.4") is the reference machine processable statement included in a certificate to declare (as a statement made by the issuing TSP) that the private key is held in a moldovan qualified signature creation device.</ns5:Description>
                                            <ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                                <mra:QcStatementSet>
                                                    <mra:QcStatement>
                                                        <mra:QcStatementId>
                                                            <ns4:Identifier Qualifier="OIDAsURN">urn:oid:0.4.0.1862.1.4</ns4:Identifier>
                                                        </mra:QcStatementId>
                                                    </mra:QcStatement>
                                                </mra:QcStatementSet>
                                            </ns5:otherCriteriaList>
                                        </mra:CertificateContentDeclarationPointedParty>
                                    </mra:CertificateContentReferenceEquivalence>
                                </mra:CertificateContentReferencesEquivalenceList>
                            </mra:TrustServiceEquivalenceInformation>
                        </mra:MutualRecognitionAgreementInformation>
                    </OtherInformation>
                </AdditionalInformation>
